overview: A "go dark" option in a commercial lease allows a tenant, typically a retailer, to cease business operations and vacate the premises while continuing to pay rent. This negotiated clause acts as a safeguard against unprofitable locations, preventing the tenant from defaulting on their lease while allowing them to cut operational costs.
